summary: Frontend-only verification of DashboardAzienda > tab 'Abbonamento' conditional rendering in 3 subscription states + checkout button integration. The 3 conditional branches render correctly. Checkout button fires POST /api/payments/checkout and successfully redirects to Stripe. Launch banner stays fixed at top (y=0 h=36) and does NOT cover subscription panel (panel y=278). NOTE: the review assumed info@caloreeclima.it is in 'active_trial', but backend seed.py sets it as subscription_status='active' + plan='pro' (see /app/backend/seed.py line 79). As a result the 'active_trial' branch (offerta-lancio-title/bullets) could not be re-verified in this iteration against that account. However iteration_6 already validated 'offerta-lancio-title' / 'offerta-lancio-bullets' rendering for an active_trial azienda, and the code branch mine.subscription_status === 'active_trial' is intact and correct in DashboardAzienda.jsx (lines 532-562).

state_matrix_results.checkout POST /api/payments/checkout: PASS — monthly button triggers POST, backend returns 200, redirects to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... (€3.99/month)
